title: Portal 2
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.18, macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), 2026-09-02; first verified on macOS 14.6 with Highball 0.7.13, 2026-08-28
notes: Works under DXVK once HDR is off, and the Portal 2 recipe turns it off for you. The story: Source's HDR path triggers a MoltenVK driver bug (a giant zero-attachment render pass aborts the GPU), which made every map load freeze or crash while menus looked fine. With mat_hdr_level 0 (written into portal2/cfg by the recipe, or set Shader Detail to not use HDR in video settings) the intro map runs at 138-147 fps at 1728x1117 on macOS 26.6.2 (DXVK, async off; 210-216 fps was measured on macOS 14.6 with async on). Re-checked on macOS 26.6.2, 2026-09-02: without the recipe (HDR level 2) the intro map load still freezes every time, once as a stuck frame and once as a white screen, with the process left alive; with the recipe two runs stayed live for the full observation. Apply the Portal 2 recipe after installing the game, keep the bottle on DXVK. The same root cause likely affects other Source titles (Portal 1, HL2, TF2, L4D2) and the same fix should transfer. Visual cost: Source's HDR bloom, minor in this game.

verified.fps: 134 was measured in the MAIN MENU on engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r1, not in play, and no in-game figure was ever recorded. A first in-game reading on 2026-09-09, engine r2 (the shipping default) with DXVK, in sp_a1_intro1 at 1280x800: 3.5 fps, stable across two readings 80 s apart, with GPU time of 2.7-2.9 ms inside a ~283 ms frame and the process at 174% CPU. So the GPU is idle 99% of the frame and something on the CPU side costs ~280 ms per frame. Caveats on that reading: the game was started directly rather than through Steam (Steam's own launcher fails here with AppError_18), with -windowed -w 1280 -h 800, and HDR was confirmed off. It has NOT been reproduced on r1, so whether this is a regression or was always true in play is unknown.
